decision_rule.summary: Return localized_collapse_consistent when the local optical and radar gates, annual-context gate, weather-context gate, and event-date anchor all pass.
decision_rule.computed_consequence: Strong local optical and radar extremes with low mean annual change and low same-day precipitation.

criteria.name: answer_schema
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with answer, four computed signal metrics, four explicit gate booleans, pass_count, and rejected_reading.

criteria.name: optical_signal_math
criteria.description: Computes optical_extreme_ratio as 67.52 and optical_peak_z as 8.64 using the stated formulas, with tolerance 0.05 for the ratio and 0.02 for z.

criteria.name: radar_signal_math
criteria.description: Computes radar_extreme_ratio as 64.09 and radar_peak_z as 11.76 using the stated formulas, with tolerance 0.05 for the ratio and 0.02 for z.

criteria.name: threshold_tests
criteria.description: Applies all four gates correctly: local_signal_gate, annual_mean_lt_0.08, precipitation_mean_lt_5_mm, and event_anchor_2022_07_03 are true.

criteria.name: final_label
criteria.description: Reports localized_collapse_consistent and pass_count 4 from the deterministic rule.

criteria.name: computed_rejection
criteria.description: Rejects a massif-wide or rain-led reading as a direct consequence of the low annual mean change and low event-day precipitation mean.

criteria.name: concise_consequence
criteria.description: Keeps the final consequence short and numeric, without adding loss, volume, runout, or attribution statements beyond the computed gates.
